flora: Platanoid_leaves (broad, maple-like leaves with prominent veins)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; broad, tactile leaf surfaces with visible but soft ribbing; rounded edges to maintain an appealing 'toy-like' quality; high-fidelity 3D textures that suggest a humid, coastal environment.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range focus on a lush cluster of Platanoid trees overhanging a damp, muddy bank. The broad leaves catch the high-key sunlight, creating a vibrant, layered canopy.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated, dark organic mud and silt interspersed with fallen broad leaves and smooth, water-worn grey stones.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright midday sun with warm highlights and soft-edged shadows that emphasize the volume of the dense foliage.
